services.name: Paint & Sip
services.desc: Grab your friends, family, or coworkers and join us at Art-Haus in Grant Park for one of our lively Paint & Sip classes. Enjoy drinks, music, prizes, and step-by-step painting instruction in a relaxed, welcoming environment. Whether you're planning a date night, girls' night out, birthday celebration, or team-building event, our classes are designed to be fun, social, and completely beginner-friendly. No experience is necessary! Our classes are perfect for both beginners and experienced painters who just want a fun and creative evening. Paint & Sip is perfect for all types of parties and events! From birthdays and bachelorette parties to baby and wedding showers and everything in between,
